panel_type_coexistence.interpretation: Two distinct original central slots differ in appearance. This is not proof that either single rectangle contains both types, nor proof of language, authorship or date.

limits: Coverage yes means all visible locally separable run strokes appear in original rectangle, not that a proposed word is lexically complete.
No means visible same-run ink is cut, potentially only a small tail; it does not imply an entire missing character or justify adding text.
Uncertain retains edge/pale-ink ambiguity; external spellings do not resolve it.
Ordinary-alphabet-like and Voynich-like are visual appearance labels, not authenticated writing-system or language assignments.
A drawing line entering a text rectangle is not automatically a second text type. F73v keeps uncertain paler adjacent marks separate from a certified mixture.
Central scene coexistence does not establish the labels name the central drawings or are dates.
Source seed fields are preserved, not retroactively corrected by these coverage observations.
Actual tool display receipts document this reviewer activity, not independent human validation.
